title: Plants beside the bones
hook: The surrounding fossil record can add habitat clues.

knows: Fossils and models can supply evidence about the past.
doesNotKnow: The bone and plant impression appear in the same illustrated layer. Plant fossils can help investigate past vegetation, while transport, mixing and dating must be checked before treating the deposit as a snapshot of a living habitat.

misconception: A plant fossil in a deposit proves the animal’s exact behavior.
objective: A hypothetical deposit contains a dinosaur bone and plant fossils from the same layer. What can the plants help investigate?
